purpose: Route ordinary Work OS requests toward useful execution, reusable learning and only the necessary validation.
rules: BUILD is required whenever an authorized useful action is available and no real blocker exists.
VERIFY is proportional to the current claim/risk and must not replace BUILD.
LEARN captures reusable delta only when it changes future work.
Routers select an execution form; they do not become new authority.

actions.output: primary outcome + protected constraints + completion boundary
targeted evidence for material claims or regression risk

routers.purpose: Route new ideas to experiment space with novelty/usefulness/cost/evidence state instead of immediate canonical promotion.
Select table/flow/diagram/chart/wireframe/map based on the information relationship and user outcome.
